```rust
use std::f64::consts;

// ---------- RNG (splitmix64 + xoshiro256**) ----------
struct Rng { s: [u64; 4] }
impl Rng {
    fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {
        let mut sm = seed;
        let mut s = [0u64; 4];
        for i in 0..4 {
            sm = sm.wrapping_add(0x9E3779B97F4A7C15);
            let mut z = sm;
            z = (z ^ (z >> 30)).wrapping_mul(0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9);
            z = (z ^ (z >> 27)).wrapping_mul(0x94D049BB133111EB);
            z ^= z >> 31;
            s[i] = z;
        }
        Rng { s }
    }
    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {
        let s = &mut self.s;
        let result = (s[1].wrapping_mul(5)).rotate_left(7).wrapping_mul(9);
        let t = s[1] << 17;
        s[2] ^= s[0]; s[3] ^= s[1]; s[1] ^= s[2]; s[0] ^= s[3];
        s[2] ^= t;
        s[3] = s[3].rotate_left(45);
        result
    }
    fn uniform(&mut self) -> f64 {
        (self.next_u64() >> 11) as f64 * (1.0 / (1u64 << 53) as f64)
    }
    // standard normal via Box-Muller
    fn normal(&mut self) -> f64 {
        loop {
            let u1 = self.uniform();
            if u1 > 1e-300 {
                let u2 = self.uniform();
                return (-2.0 * u1.ln()).sqrt() * (2.0 * consts::PI * u2).cos();
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```rust
//! HARD04_ECON_REASON verifier (Rust, std only)
//! 1) Symmetric BNE of the first-price auction with U[0,1] values: b(v) = (n-1)/n * v
//!    - Monte Carlo best-response check
//!    - Uniqueness via ODE integration (RK4)
//! 2) Revenue equivalence with second-price: (n-1)/(n+1), via surplus identity
//! 3) Power simulation for a 50-auction live experiment (n=4), pre-registered statistic

use std::f64::consts::PI;

struct Rng { s: [u64; 4] }

impl Rng {
    fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {
        let mut x = seed;
        let mut s = [0u64; 4];
        for slot in s.iter_mut() {
            x = x.wrapping_add(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15);
            let mut z = x;
            z = (z ^ (z >> 30)).wrapping_mul(0xBF58_476D_1CE4_E5B9);
            z = (z ^ (z >> 27)).wrapping_mul(0x94D0_49BB_1331_11EB);
            *slot = z ^ (z >> 31);
        }
        Rng { s }
    }
    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {
        let s = &mut self.s;
        let r = s[1].wrapping_mul(5).rotate_left(7).wrapping_mul(9);
        let t = s[1] << 17;
        s[2] ^= s[0]; s[3] ^= s[1]; s[1] ^= s[2]; s[0] ^= s[3];
        s[2] ^= t; s[3] = s[3].rotate_left(45);
        r
    }
    fn uniform(&mut self) -> f64 { (self.next_u64() >> 11) as f64 * (1.0 / (1u64 << 53) as f64) }
    fn normal(&mut self) -> f64 {
        let u1 = self.uniform().max(1e-12);
        let u2 = self.uniform();
        (-2.0 * u1.ln()).sqrt() * (2.0 * PI * u2).cos()
    }
}

fn bne(v: f64, n: usize) -> f64 { (n - 1) as f64 / n as f64 * v }

fn order_stats_revenue_formula(n: usize) -> (f64, f64) {
    // E[max], E[second-highest] of n iid U[0,1]
    (n as f64 / (n + 1) as f64, (n - 1) as f64 / (n + 1) as f64)
}
```

```rust
fn mc_equilibrium_check(n: usize, m: usize, rng: &mut Rng) -> (f64, f64) {
    // For a grid of v's, compare the payoff at z=v against the best z on a grid
    let zs: Vec<f64> = (0..=200).map(|i| i as f64 / 200.0).collect();
    let vs: Vec<f64> = (1..=19).map(|i| i as f64 / 20.0).collect();
    let mut max_gap = 0.0f64;
    let mut max_dev_gain = 0.0f64;
    for &v in &vs {
        let mut payoffs = vec![0.0f64; zs.len()];
        for _ in 0..m {
            let mut y = 0.0f64; // highest of n-1 opponents
            for _ in 0..n - 1 { let u = rng.uniform(); if u > y { y = u; } }
            for (k, &z) in zs.iter().enumerate() {
                if z > y { payoffs[k] += v - bne(z, n); }
            }
        }
        let eq_idx = zs.iter().position(|&z| (z - v).abs() < 1e-9).unwrap();
        let best = payoffs.iter().cloned().fold(f64::NEG_INFINITY, f64::max);
        max_dev_gain = max_dev_gain.max((best - payoffs[eq_idx]) / m as f64);
        // also record argmax distance
    }
    (max_gap, max_dev_gain)
}
```

```rust
fn ode_uniqueness(n: usize) {
    let h = 1e-4;
    let mut v = 1e-6;
    let mut b = 0.0;
    let f = |v: f64, b: f64| (n - 1) as f64 * (v - b) / v;
    let mut max_err = 0.0;
    while v < 1.0 - 1e-12 {
        let k1 = f(v, b);
        let k2 = f(v + h / 2.0, b + h / 2.0 * k1);
        let k3 = f(v + h / 2.0, b + h / 2.0 * k2);
        let k4 = f(v + h, b + h * k3);
        b += h / 6.0 * (k1 + 2.0 * k2 + 2.0 * k3 + k4);
        v += h;
        max_err = max_err.max((b - bne(v, n)).abs());
    }
    println!("ODE RK4 max |b_num - (n-1)v/n| = {:.3e}", max_err);
}
```

//"'! HARD04_ECON_REASON — sealed-bid first-price auction, n>=2 risk-neutral
//! bidders, i.i.d. private values ~ U[0,1].
//!
//! Verifies in plain Rust (std only, no Python):
//!   1. Symmetric differentiable BNE b(v) = (n-1)/n * v
//!      - Monte-Carlo best-response check (no profitable deviation)
//!      - ODE uniqueness (RK4 integration with boundary b(0)=0)
//!   2. Revenue equivalence vs second-price: both give (n-1)/(n+1),
//!      via the surplus identity (no Myerson machinery).
//!   3. Power simulation for the live experiment: 50 auctions, n=4,
//!      one pre-registered statistic (cluster-level t on bid deviation
//!      from equilibrium shading).

use std::f64::consts::PI;

// ---------------- RNG: xoshiro256** seeded by splitmix64 ----------------
struct Rng {
    s: [u64; 4],
}

impl Rng {
    fn new(seed: u64) -> Self {
        let mut x = seed;
        let mut s = [0u64; 4];
        for slot in s.iter_mut() {
            x = x.wrapping_add(0x9E37_79B9_7F4A_7C15);
            let mut z = x;
            z = (z ''^ (z >> 30)).wrapping_mul(0xBF58_476D_1CE4_E5B9);
            z = (z ''^ (z >> 27)).wrapping_mul(0x94D0_49BB_1331_11EB);
            *slot = z ''^ (z >> 31);
        }
        Rng { s }
    }

    fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {
        let s = &mut self.s;
        let r = s[1].wrapping_mul(5).rotate_left(7).wrapping_mul(9);
        let t = s[1] << 17;
        s[2] ''^= s[0];
        s[3] ''^= s[1];
        s[1] ''^= s[2];
        s[0] ''^= s[3];
        s[2] ''^= t;
        s[3] = s[3].rotate_left(45);
        r
    }

    fn uniform(&mut self) -> f64 {
        (self.next_u64() >> 11) as f64 * (1.0 / (1u64 << 53) as f64)
    }

    fn normal(&mut self) -> f64 {
        let u1 = self.uniform().max(1e-12);
        let u2 = self.uniform();
        (-2.0 * u1.ln()).sqrt() * (2.0 * PI * u2).cos()
    }
}

// ---------------- Theory ----------------
fn bne(v: f64, n: usize) -> f64 {
    (n - 1) as f64 / n as f64 * v
}

// ---------------- 1a. Monte-Carlo best-response check ----------------
fn mc_equilibrium(n: usize, m: usize, rng: &mut Rng) {
    let zs: Vec<f64> = (0..=200).map(|i| i as f64 / 200.0).collect();
    let vs: Vec<f64> = (1..=19).map(|i| i as f64 / 20.0).collect();
    let mut max_gain = 0.0f64;
    let mut max_argmax_dist = 0.0f64;
    for &v in &vs {
        let mut payoffs = vec![0.0f64; zs.len()];
        for _ in 0..m {
            // y = highest opposing value among n-1 opponents
            let mut y = 0.0f64;
            for _ in 0..n - 1 {
                let u = rng.uniform();
                if u > y {
                    y = u;
                }
            }
            for (k, &z) in zs.iter().enumerate() {
                if z > y {
                    payoffs[k] += v - bne(z, n);
                }
            }
        }
        let eq_idx = (v * 200.0).round() as usize;
        let mut best_idx = 0usize;
        for (k, &p) in payoffs.iter().enumerate() {
            if p > payoffs[best_idx] {
                best_idx = k;
            }
        }
        let gain = (payoffs[best_idx] - payoffs[eq_idx]) / m as f64;
        max_gain = max_gain.max(gain);
        max_argmax_dist = max_argmax_dist.max((zs[best_idx] - v).abs());
    }
    println!(
        "  n={n}: max deviation gain over b(v) = {max_gain:.6}, max |argmax z - v| = {max_argmax_dist:.4}  (m={m})"
    );
}

// ---------------- 1b. ODE uniqueness via RK4 ----------------
fn ode_uniqueness(n: usize) {
    // b'"'(v) = (n-1)(v - b(v))/v, boundary b(0)=0.
    let f = |v: f64, b: f64| (n - 1) as f64 * (v - b) / v;
    let h = 1e-4;
    let mut v = 1e-6;
    let mut b = 0.0;
    let mut max_err = 0.0f64;
    while v < 1.0 - 1e-12 {
        let k1 = f(v, b);
        let k2 = f(v + h / 2.0, b + h / 2.0 * k1);
        let k3 = f(v + h / 2.0, b + h / 2.0 * k2);
        let k4 = f(v + h, b + h * k3);
        b += h / 6.0 * (k1 + 2.0 * k2 + 2.0 * k3 + k4);
        v += h;
        max_err = max_err.max((b - bne(v, n)).abs());
    }
    println"'!("  n={n}: RK4 from b(0)=0 -> max |b_num - (n-1)v/n| = {max_err:.3e}");
}

// ---------------- 2. Revenue comparison ----------------
fn mc_revenue(n: usize, draws: usize, rng: &mut Rng) -> (f64, f64, f64, f64) {
    let mut fp = 0.0;
    let mut sp = 0.0;
    let mut vmax = 0.0;
    let mut surplus = 0.0; // sum over bidders of v''^n/n realized? use winner surplus
    for _ in 0..draws {
        let mut m1 = 0.0f64;
        let mut m2 = 0.0f64;
        for _ in 0..n {
            let u = rng.uniform();
            if u >= m1 {
                m2 = m1;
                m1 = u;
            } else if u > m2 {
                m2 = u;
            }
        }
        fp += bne(m1, n); // winner pays own shaded bid
        sp += m2; // winner pays second-highest (truthful bids)
        vmax += m1;
        surplus += m1.powi(n as i32) / n as f64; // winner info rent U(v)=v''^n/n
    }
    let d = draws as f64;
    (fp / d, sp / d, vmax / d, surplus / d)
}

fn surplus_identity_check(n: usize, m: usize, rng: &mut Rng) {
    println!("  surplus per type U(v): FP equilibrium vs SP truthful (theory v''^{n}/{n})");
    for &v in &[0.3f64, 0.5, 0.8, 0.95] {
        let mut u_sp = 0.0;
        for _ in 0..m {
            let mut y = 0.0f64;
            for _ in 0..n - 1 {
                let u = rng.uniform();
                if u > y {
                    y = u;
                }
            }
            if y < v {
                u_sp += v - y;
            }
        }
        u_sp /= m as f64;
        let u_fp = v.powi((n - 1) as i32) * (v - bne(v, n)); // win prob * margin
        let theory = v.powi(n as i32) / n as f64;
        println!(
            "    v={v:.2}: U_FP={u_fp:.4}  U_SP(MC)={u_sp:.4}  v''^n/n={theory:.4}"
        );
    }
}

// ---------------- 3. Power simulation for the live experiment ----------------
// Design: K=50 auctions, N=4 bidders each, one-shot, between-subjects.
// Behavior model: bid = beta*v + session shock + idiosyncratic noise, clipped.
// Pre-registered statistic: T = sqrt(K) * mean(y_j) / sd(y_j),
//   y_j = auction-mean of (bid - 0.75*value); two-sided t_{49}, alpha=0.05.
fn power_sim(rng: &mut Rng) {
    const K: usize = 50; // auctions
    const N: usize = 4; // bidders per auction
    const SESSIONS: usize = 10; // 5 auctions per session
    const PER_SESSION: usize = K / SESSIONS;
    const REPS: usize = 10_000;
    const SIGMA_U: f64 = 0.10; // within-auction bid noise (sd)
    const SIGMA_C: f64 = 0.03; // session-level aggressiveness (sd)
    const TCRIT: f64 = 2.0095752; // t_{49, 0.975}
    const BETA0: f64 = 0.75; // equilibrium slope (n-1)/n for n=4

    let betas: Vec<f64> = (75..=90).map(|b| b as f64 / 100.0).collect();
    let mut rej = vec![0usize; betas.len()];
    let mut meandev = vec![0.0f64; betas.len()];

    for _ in 0..REPS {
        for (bi, &beta) in betas.iter().enumerate() {
            let mut clmeans = [0.0f64; K];
            for s in 0..SESSIONS {
                let c = SIGMA_C * rng.normal();
                for j in 0..PER_SESSION {
                    let idx = s * PER_SESSION + j;
                    let mut acc = 0.0f64;
                    for _ in 0..N {
                        let v = rng.uniform();
                        let bid = (beta * v + c + SIGMA_U * rng.normal()).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
                        acc += bid - BETA0 * v;
                    }
                    clmeans[idx] = acc / N as f64;
                }
            }
            let m = clmeans.iter().sum::<f64>() / K as f64;
            let var: f64 =
                clmeans.iter().map(|x| (x - m) * (x - m)).sum::<f64>() / (K - 1) as f64;
            let t = m / var.sqrt() * (K as f64).sqrt();
            if t.abs() > TCRIT {
                rej[bi] += 1;
            }
            meandev[bi] += m;
        }
    }

    println!("  behavior model: bid = beta*v + N(0,{SIGMA_C})_session + N(0,{SIGMA_U}), clipped to [0,1]");
    println!("  K={K} auctions, N={N}, REPS={REPS}, two-sided alpha=0.05, tcrit={TCRIT}");
    println!("  beta   mean(y)     rejection rate (power)");
    let mut mde_beta = f64::NAN;
    for (bi, &beta) in betas.iter().enumerate() {
        let rate = rej[bi] as f64 / REPS as f64;
        let md = meandev[bi] / REPS as f64;
        if mde_beta.is_nan() && rate >= 0.80 {
            mde_beta = beta;
        }
        println!("  {beta:.2}   {md:+.4}      {rate:.3}");
    }
    if !mde_beta.is_nan() {
        println!(
            "  -> power>=0.80 from beta={mde_beta:.2} (mean bid deviation {dd:+.4} ~ shading gap of {gap:.1} pts vs theory 25% at mean v=0.5)",
            dd = (mde_beta - BETA0) * 0.5,
            gap = (mde_beta - BETA0) * 100.0
        );
    }
}

fn main() {
    let mut rng = Rng::new(0xAUC7104);
    println!("== 1. Symmetric BNE of first-price auction, U[0,1] values ==");
    println!("theory: b(v) = (n-1)/n * v");
    println!("best-response check (payoff from deviating to bid b(z), z in [0,1]):");
    for &n in &[2usize, 3, 4, 6, 9] {
        mc_equilibrium(n, 20_000, &mut rng);
    }
    println!("ODE uniqueness (all C != 0 solutions blow up at 0; b(0)=0 pins C=0):");
    for &n in &[2usize, 4, 9] {
        ode_uniqueness(n);
    }

    println!();
    println!("== 2. Revenue: first-price vs second-price ==");
    println!("  n   E[b(V_(n))]   E[V_(n-1)]   (n-1)/(n+1)   E[V_(n)]-E[U]");
    for &n in &[2usize, 3, 4, 5, 9] {
        let (fp, sp, emax, esur) = mc_revenue(n, 1_000_000, &mut rng);
        let formula = (n - 1) as f64 / (n + 1) as f64;
        println!(
            "  {n}   {fp:.4f}        {sp:.4f}       {formula:.4f}        {:.4}",
            emax - esur
        );
    }
    surplus_identity_check(4, 200_000, &mut rng);

    println!();
    println!("== 3. Power of the 50-auction live experiment (n=4) ==");
    power_sim(&mut rng);
}
